FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Melody Makers Music Sales & Repair, we specialize in the sale and repair of a wide variety of musical instruments, including guitars, pianos, woodwinds, and brass instruments. Our operations include providing expert repair services by highly qualified technicians with extensive experience in instrument maintenance, ensuring that all repairs meet our rigorous quality standards. We have implemented secure display cases for high-value instruments to minimize theft risk, and we comply with all local business licensing and safety regulations. Our goal is to deliver exceptional customer service by educating our clients on instrument care and maintenance while fostering a welcoming community atmosphere through workshops and engagement events. Please note that we maintain an operational alarm and security system to ensure the safety of our instruments and enhance customer peace of mind.

Our store specializes in selling and repairing musical instruments, and we often conduct transactions and repairs in-store without utilizing an operational alarm or security system.
